DEDR 1911 identifies Kannada kūḻ (ಕೂಳು) ‘boiled rice, food’ as part of Proto-Dravidian *kūḻ ‘porridge’. Tamil kūḻ means thick gruel/porridge; Tulu kūru/kūlu/kūḷu means boiled rice. This is a genuine cognate set, but the meanings range from porridge to boiled rice and food; it should not be treated as an exact synonym for every use of ‘food’.
